back.en: Testes, epididymis, sperm duct, seminal vesicle, prostate, urethra, penis
back.bm: Testis, epididimis, duktus sperma, vesikel semen, prostat, uretra, zakar

back.en: Ovaries, Fallopian tubes, uterus, cervix, vagina
back.bm: Ovari, tiub Falopio, uterus, serviks, faraj

back.en: Sperm: 4 per cell, continuous from puberty. Ova: 1 per cell (+ polar bodies), monthly
back.bm: Sperma: 4 setiap sel, berterusan dari akil baligh. Ovum: 1 setiap sel (+ jasad kutub), bulanan

back.en: Pituitary hormones: FSH grows follicles; LH triggers ovulation and corpus luteum
back.bm: Hormon pituitari: FSH membesarkan folikel; LH mencetuskan ovulasi dan korpus luteum

back.en: Oestrogen: rebuilds endometrium. Progesterone: maintains it for pregnancy
back.bm: Estrogen: membina semula endometrium. Progesteron: mengekalkannya untuk kehamilan

back.en: PMS: mood swings before menstruation. Menopause: cycle stops (~45–55) as hormones fall
back.bm: PMS: perubahan emosi sebelum haid. Menopaus: kitar berhenti (~45–55) apabila hormon menurun

back.en: Zygote → cleavage → morula → blastocyst → implantation → embryo → foetus (8 weeks)
back.bm: Zigot → pembelahan → morula → blastosista → penempelan → embrio → fetus (8 minggu)

back.en: Exchange of O₂, nutrients, CO₂, waste; passes antibodies; secretes hormones; barrier to some germs
back.bm: Pertukaran O₂, nutrien, CO₂, bahan buangan; memindahkan antibodi; merembes hormon; penghalang sesetengah kuman

back.en: Identical: one zygote splits, same genes. Fraternal: two eggs, two sperm, different genes
back.bm: Seiras: satu zigot terbahagi, gen sama. Tak seiras: dua telur, dua sperma, gen berbeza

back.en: Infertility, STIs (syphilis, gonorrhoea, HIV), cervical and prostate cancer
back.bm: Kemandulan, jangkitan kelamin (sifilis, gonorea, HIV), kanser serviks dan prostat

back.en: Sigmoid; rapid growth in infancy and puberty, slow in childhood, stops in adulthood
back.bm: Sigmoid; pesat semasa bayi dan akil baligh, perlahan semasa kanak-kanak, berhenti semasa dewasa

back.en: Step-shaped (intermittent) — size increases only after each moult
back.bm: Bentuk tangga (berselang) — saiz bertambah hanya selepas setiap salinan kulit

back.en: Male hormone from the testes: controls sperm production and male secondary sexual characteristics
back.bm: Hormon lelaki daripada testis: mengawal penghasilan sperma dan ciri seks sekunder lelaki

back.en: About 28 days; ovulation usually around day 14
back.bm: Kira-kira 28 hari; ovulasi biasanya sekitar hari ke-14

back.en: Track height, length, volume or mass over time; dry mass is the most accurate but destroys the sample
back.bm: Ukur tinggi, panjang, isi padu atau jisim mengikut masa; jisim kering paling tepat tetapi memusnahkan sampel
